effect.exoblade.bleeding.desc: Causes the target to bleed over time.
effect.exoblade.electrocution.desc: When hit by an Exorium Axe, the entity gets struck by lightning and has chances of affecting nearby mobs with electrocution
effect.exoblade.stun.desc: Unable to move, path or strike
tooltip.exoblade.carbon_steel_scythe: A scythe made of carbon steel, known for its durability and sharpness. Has built in sweeping edge for AOE attacks.
tooltip.exoblade.carbon_steel_dagger: A dagger made of carbon steel, known for its durability and sharpness. Has 20% chance of bleeding effect on enemies.
tooltip.exoblade.carbon_steel_hatchet: Throwable Axe that can still be used for everyday lumbering.
tooltip.exoblade.carbon_steel_spear: Primitive yet can poke enemies as far as 4 blocks away.
tooltip.exoblade.exorium_sword: A short burst of adrenaline surges through your veins as you cling to this sword.
tooltip.exoblade.exorium_sword_ability: Right-click to gain 10 seconds of speed and jump boost. Cooldown 20s
tooltip.exoblade.exorium_dagger: An exotic blade that opens wounds that will not easily close. 30% chance to inflict Bleeding II.
tooltip.exoblade.exorium_axe: A powerful Axe that can summon a lightning strike upon enemy hit.
tooltip.exoblade.exorium_hammer: A strong Hammer that can concuss an enemy with a chance of disabling shields. Blocking prevents concussion effect
tooltip.exoblade.exorium_scythe: Has built in sweeping edge for AOE attacks and 50% chance of bleeding I effect in a short duration.
tooltip.exoblade.exorium_spear: Has 1 more reach longer than carbon steel spear
